summary: Short-range, all-aspect infrared-homing air-to-air missile (the L's airframe, a reduced-smoke motor)
motor: Hercules and Bermite Mk 36 Mod 11 solid rocket, reduced smoke

warhead_kg.note: the AIM-9X's 20.8 lb warhead: the AIM-9X 'has the same rocket motor and warhead as the AIM-9M' (USAF fact sheet)

range_km.note: the Sidewinder family's '0.6 to 22 mi', which the article marks 'not verified in body'

power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's us_aim9m_sidewinder (PBXN-3); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: PBXN-3 (86 % HMX in nylon) is not in Cooper's table: as Comp B (2.70) - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00222, its base 0.00056, its fins' friction 0.00285 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.0351 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.988 for its fineness 22.5 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)

wt-datamine.title: War Thunder datamine: rocketguns weapon files (a game reference: the game's own values, not a manufacturer's)
